item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00343","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C05","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 is the strongest plausible drafting source because it immediately precedes the child, regulates the same Career Compensation Act framework, defines the same key terms by reference to section 102, and repeatedly applies duties concerning disability retirement pay to the same class of members and former members through the Secretary concerned. The child adapts that vocabulary and administrative allocation to the distinct section 411 election process. C05 contains a nearly verbatim supplemental-regulations clause and closely related statutory context, but that clause is routine and less material by itself. C04 shares the same Act and departmental framework but has substantially less distinctive overlap.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"As used in this order the term \"Secretary\" shall have the meaning prescribed therefor by section 102(f) of the Career Compensation Act of 1949.","parent_excerpt":"The terms \"uniformed services\" and \"Secretary\" as used in these regulations shall have the meaning prescribed therefor by subsections (a) and (f), respectively, of section 102 of the Career Compensation Act of 1949.","explanation":"Distinctively close definitional language cites the same subsection of the same recent statute for the same central administrative term."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary concerned shall determine and inform each member and each former member of the uniformed service or services under his jurisdiction ... [of] the effect of section 402(h) ... with respect to ... disability retirement pay.","parent_excerpt":"all duties, powers, and functions incident to the payment of disability retirement pay of members or former members of the uniformed services ... shall ... be vested in the Secretary concerned.","explanation":"Both use the same actor, beneficiary class, and disability-retirement subject, with the child adapting the machinery from administration of payment to administration of statutory elections."}]}
